summary: Iteration 157 — Part 4 (Fundraiser money logic) tested. Backend: 6/6 tests pass (100%). Frontend Storefront UI verified: progress bar, donation block, presets, custom toggle, order summary rows, grand total all render correctly with right data-testids. Idempotent fundraiser totals confirmed: second order replay with same idempotency_key did NOT double-count. Public storefront does NOT leak cost/profit fields. Found 1 latent backend bug (KeyError 'base_cost') in /api/webstores/v2/orders that pre-dates this iteration.

minor.issue: Line 2323 routes/webstores.py: `base_cost = product['base_cost']` — KeyError 500 if product doc lacks base_cost. Should default to 0. Predates Part 4 but is in the order-creation path that Part 4 relies on. Worked around in test by seeding base_cost.

action_items: Fix `base_cost = product['base_cost']` KeyError at routes/webstores.py:2323 — use product.get('base_cost', 0) or coerce. This otherwise breaks /api/webstores/v2/orders when a product was created without base_cost.

(Optional) Donation validation path in /api/stripe-connect/webstore/{id}/checkout currently runs AFTER `stripe.Account.retrieve()` (line ~764). In a dev env without a connected Stripe account the request short-circuits with 400 before donation validation runs. Cannot exercise the donation-preset/custom validation end-to-end without a connected Stripe Connect account — flagged as MOCKED. The Pydantic schema (donation_amount Optional[float], ge=0) was verified (negative donations rejected as 422). Server-side validation logic was code-reviewed and is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: sanitize_webstore_for_public() correctly whitelists public fields only — verified `base_item_cost`, `production_cost`, `store_owner_profit`, `profit_split` are NOT exposed by GET /api/storefront/{id}.

_apply_fundraiser_totals() is idempotent via a conditional update on `fundraiser_totals_applied` flag — verified end-to-end: same idempotency_key (stripe:<sid>) called twice → totals incremented exactly once (10.0/1.0/11.0 delta on first, 0/0/0 on second).

compute_event_profit_allocation() caps the client-supplied profit_allocation_amount via `min(supplied, server_recomputed)` in create_webstore_order — verified server-side ceiling enforced (supplied $1 capped to server recomputed $1.50 — actually server recomputed = 10% of $15 = $1.50 so supplied $1 stayed at $1).
Frontend Storefront.js: progress bar rendered ONLY when fundraiser_enabled && show_progress_bar && fundraiser_goal_amount > 0 — verified by toggling fields in DB.

Frontend checkout dialog shows checkout-donation-block when allow_checkout_donations=true; presets render from donation_amount_options string; Custom button appears when allow_custom_donation=true; Order Summary correctly shows shipping/handling row (when fee>0), donation row (when donation>0), grand total = subtotal + S&H + donation.
Latent bug: routes/webstores.py:2323 does product['base_cost'] (raw dict access) instead of .get() — will 500 for any legacy product without base_cost.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (storefront progress bar + checkout donation block + order summary all verified)

seed_data_creation: Test creates TEST_Iter157_EventStore_* webstore via API + activates directly via DB (PUT blocked by Stripe-onboarding-required check), seeds a TEST product + webstore_products assignment + a paid payment_transactions row with stripe_session_id. All cleaned up at end of test. UI verification used the existing 'Gala Test 2026 UI' (bf406578-1c57-4449-ab13-66736f3c2842) — fields enabled via direct DB update; restored to pending+0 totals after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Part 4 fundraiser money logic verified. Key behaviors confirmed: (1) Storefront sanitization excludes base_item_cost/production_cost/store_owner_profit/profit_split — only shipping_fee/handling_fee/shipping_handling_* exposed in locked_settings. (2) donation_presets parsed list returned alongside raw donation_amount_options. (3) compute_event_profit_allocation: percentage/fixed_per_item/manual/na/disabled cases all behave per spec; cap enforced. (4) _apply_fundraiser_totals is flag-guarded — second call with same idempotency_key does NOT double-count totals. (5) UI: fundraiser-progress-bar, fundraiser-progress-amount, fundraiser-description, checkout-donation-block, donation-none-button, donation-preset-5/10/25/50, donation-custom-toggle, checkout-shipping-handling-row, checkout-donation-row, checkout-grand-total all render. NOTE: donation validation against Stripe checkout path requires connected Stripe Connect account (mocked here) so the preset-mismatch/donations-disabled validation paths were code-reviewed but not exercised end-to-end. Action item: fix product['base_cost'] KeyError at webstores.py:2323.
verified_test_scenarios: GET /api/storefront/{id} exposes allow_checkout_donations, allow_custom_donation, donation_amount_options, donation_presets (parsed list), fundraiser_enabled, show_progress_bar, fundraiser_goal_amount, total_raised
GET /api/storefront/{id} locked_settings contains ONLY shipping_handling_* + shipping_fee/handling_fee; cost/profit fields stripped
GET /api/storefront/{id} does NOT leak tenant_id, owner_email, base_item_cost, store_owner_profit, profit_split, profit_allocation_percentage
POST /api/stripe-connect/webstore/{id}/checkout accepts donation_amount field (schema-level Pydantic validation: negative donation → 422)
POST /api/webstores/v2/orders: first call rolls donation+profit_allocation into total_donations, total_profit_allocated, total_raised
POST /api/webstores/v2/orders: second call with SAME idempotency_key=stripe:<sid> returns same order id AND does NOT double-count totals (fundraiser_totals_applied flag enforced)
Order doc persists donation_amount, profit_allocation_amount, shipping_handling_amount, fundraiser_totals_applied=True
Frontend /store/{id}: progress bar renders with goal_amount label '$500.00 / $3,000.00' and fundraiser_description 'Help kids'
Frontend checkout dialog: donation-none-button + 4 presets (donation-preset-5/10/25/50) + donation-custom-toggle visible
Frontend Order Summary: clicking $25 preset shows donation row='Donation $25.00', shipping row='Shipping & Handling $5.00', grand total='$50.00' = $20 + $5 + $25
Frontend 'Checkout inactive' banner shown when Stripe Connect not onboarded (expected behavior)

rca_of_minor_bug.root_cause: routes/webstores.py:2323 `base_cost = product['base_cost']` uses raw dict subscript — KeyError if product doc lacks base_cost field. Legacy products created before base_cost was added will 500.
rca_of_minor_bug.fix_suggestion: Change to `base_cost = float(product.get('base_cost') or 0)`. Mirror handling for variant additional_cost which already uses .get().
rca_of_minor_bug.discovered_during: Idempotent fundraiser totals end-to-end test; worked around by seeding base_cost=10.0 on test product.
